subcategory_text: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-13, PS-01, PS-07, PS-09
ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 7.3, Annex A.6.1, Annex A.6.2, Annex A.6.3, Annex A.6.4, Annex A.6.5, Annex A.6.6, Annex A.6.7 (+1 more)
CRI Profile v2.0: GV.RR-04, GV.RR-04.01, GV.RR-04.02, GV.RR-04.03
implementation_examples: Integrate cybersecurity risk management considerations into human resources processes (e.g., personnel screening, onboarding, change notification, offboarding)
Consider cybersecurity knowledge to be a positive factor in hiring, training, and retention decisions
Conduct background checks prior to onboarding new personnel for sensitive roles, and periodically repeat background checks for personnel with such roles
Define and enforce obligations for personnel to be aware of, adhere to, and uphold security policies as they relate to their roles
assessment_objectives: Determine whether cybersecurity is included in human resources practices.

Determine whether activities are conducted to integrate cybersecurity risk management considerations into human resources processes (e.g., personnel screening, onboarding, change notification, offboarding).
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that consider cybersecurity knowledge to be a positive factor in hiring, training, and retention decisions.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
